ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The visible fluke surface exhibits a high-contrast ratio of approximately 85% low-intensity (black) pixels to 15% high-intensity (white) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly contiguous low-intensity black region across the superior and distal portions of both lobes; high-intensity white mottling and focal spots are localized along the inferior proximal margin at the waterline.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The superior trailing boundary exhibits irregular serrations; the right lobe contains at least four distinct peaks with a 4-7 pixel vertical amplitude relative to the edge mean.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the superior trailing edges, characterized by a gradual outward sweep tapering into rounded distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least five isolated white pixel clusters (2-4 pixel diameter) scattered across the dark pigment of both lobes, suggesting localized scarring.

other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric truncation observed on the far right lobe tip compared to the more rounded left tip.
